evidence.claim: Fluence reported USD 649.8 million of quarterly revenue, a 5.1% GAAP gross margin, a USD 44.3 million net loss, negative USD 29.3 million adjusted EBITDA, more than USD 1.44 billion of order intake and USD 6.4 billion of backlog.
